name: Dwight Schrute
look: Rainn Wilson as Dwight Schrute from The Office, in wire-rimmed glasses, a pale green short-sleeved shirt and a dark patterned tie, stares straight at the camera with a stern, deadpan face. A coworker in a blue shirt is blurred behind him.
use: Pedantic corrections in Dwight's know-it-all voice. The top quotes a common statement, and the bottom answers with "False." and an absurdly literal correction, or opens with "Question:" and a smug follow-up.
examples: False. Cereal is an anytime food.
describe: office guy with glasses staring seriously at the camera
dwight from the office with a deadpan face
man in a short sleeve shirt and tie looking stern
guy correcting you by saying false
serious coworker in glasses and a green shirt
origin: A still of Rainn Wilson as Dwight Schrute in the US version of The Office.
